args.request:
Adversarially test the current dealership as a user with very little technical knowledge. Reproduce consequential failures, challenge the interpretation, research bounded alternatives and implement supported improvements locally. Fix name/year search order/spacing with precision controls and source identifier compatibility; recover incompatible game/variant/category filters without erasing available restrictions; preserve usable sidebar/list space with keyboard-operable optional filters; implement native Enter submission, visible provider disclosure and honest cancellation/pending/timeout recovery; correct diagnostic paths and documentation. Preserve unrelated dirty work, independent working models, source assets, compiled catalog and existing vendor/provider dependencies. Save findings, counterevidence, coverage, experiments, decisions and limitations. Review raw diffs against captured dirty task baseline and real current check/browser evidence. No publication authorized; no new execution dependency added. Full suite has72 passing top-level check commands, no top-level skips, and one nested optional Pillow test skipped; the final single-line diagnostic repair has its affected dealership/viewer checks rerun; external/provider, screen-reader, real-device and game-fidelity limits remain explicit. All model disagreements/escalations are preserved and resolved independently where required.
 Review only the listed complete-file scope; all file scopes together cover the unchanged final patch. The previous whole-gate request failed operationally with max_tokens_exceeded and is retained; these bounded calls repair its input budget.

files.diff:
--- a/dealership/dealership/README.md
+++ b/dealership/dealership/README.md
@@ -42,6 +42,11 @@
 language filter (served by `tools/serve_library.py`) matches exact game/variant phrases
 locally and sends other wording to the TypeSafe model; uncertain or unavailable
 judgments leave existing filters unchanged and show a status message naming the reason.
+The optional form is under **More filters**, submits with Enter, and displays the provider
+routing explanation beside the field. Name/year/code search stays offline, accepts words in
+either order and keeps unknown names/unsupported spellings as explicit empty results. When
+changing games or source variants, incompatible choices are cleared with a visible explanation;
+still-available restrictions remain selected.
 
 The display baker supports static node translations, quaternion rotations, affine matrices,
 nonuniform scale and triangle indices of 8, 16 or 32 bits. Preserve normal attributes and

--- a/research/README.md
+++ b/research/README.md
@@ -6,6 +6,8 @@
 
 | Note | Holds |
 | --- | --- |
+| `dealership-teardown-2026-10-12.md` | Novice-user dealership teardown, search/filter/layout/request recovery improvements, coverage ledger, original reproductions and final verification |
+| `dealership-usability-alternatives-2026-10-12.md` | Primary-source comparison of native search/filter/form/disclosure improvements and deferred fuzzy search, with eligibility limits |
 | `ai-agent-reverse-engineering-workflow-2026-10-11.md` | Primary-source tool comparisons, a bounded agent workflow, reusable prompts, September 27–October 11 releases and videos, and source-quality checks |
 | `semantic-filter-teardown-2026-10-11.md` | Natural-language filter teardown: offline phrase routing, fail-closed model composition fixes, availability reporting, frozen labeled before/after measurements and Jev receipts |
 | `gran-turismo-shading-2026-10-11.md` | Why GT cars render shadowed: inverted winding and in-plane stored normals under double-sided lighting, all-728-car rebuild of candidate fixes, headless viewer render matrix, rejected modulation/black-face hypotheses, Jev receipts, ranked fixes |
@@ -38,7 +40,7 @@
 
 - Gran Turismo dynamic wheel behavior, additional colour sets, PS1 rendering fidelity, runtime LOD selection, per-car metadata joins and retail identities remain open. Native extraction is established in `gran-turismo-extraction.md`; static body/first-colour conversion and dealership import are established in `gran-turismo-library.md`; native wheel templates and neutral assembly are established in `gran-turismo-wheels.md`. The shadowed dealership look is traced to inverted body winding and in-plane stored normals in `gran-turismo-shading-2026-10-11.md`, with a measured exporter repair; implementing it, connectivity-based orientation, runtime colour/raw-bit rewrites and the in-game look of black flat faces remain open.
 
-- Natural-language filter: exact phrases are decided offline and measured in [the teardown](semantic-filter-teardown-2026-10-11.md); model-path option-order stability, the `original` alias outside Redline, an in-page disclosure before sending and the server/UI timeout mismatch (30 s vs 20 s) remain open.
+- Natural-language filter: exact phrases are decided offline and measured in [the filter teardown](semantic-filter-teardown-2026-10-11.md). The dealership now has visible provider disclosure, Enter submission, request recovery and a 35 s UI budget for the existing 30 s provider request, verified in [the dealership teardown](dealership-teardown-2026-10-12.md). Model-path option-order stability, the `original` alias outside Redline, and the source viewer's disclosure/20 s timeout remain open.
 
 - Dealership surface tones use vertex sampling rather than semantic glass/paint segmentation; residual decals and dark details are approximate. Full game-render fidelity remains open.

claims: The full-suite logs record 72 passing top-level check commands and one nested optional Pillow test skipped; the two affected checks were rerun after the final diagnostic-path correction and passed.
The final dealership regression passed its search precision, filter recovery and semantic request-lifecycle controls.
